data.title: 伊卡洛斯 · 店打烊后收起最后一把椅子
data.description: 客人离开后，还剩一把木椅留在窗边。伊卡洛斯先收拢翅膀，再抓住椅背和坐板把它翻上桌。椅腿刚抬过桌沿，白围裙上已经落了一缕夕光。
data.action: 双手抓住椅背和坐板，将木椅翻到桌上
data.lighting: 落日穿过咖啡店窗玻璃
data.camera: 全身侧前景，围裙与椅脚可见
data.promptProse: At closing time in a quiet cafe, Ikaros lifts the last wooden chair upside down onto a table. One hand holds the back and the other supports the seat. Her wings are folded well clear of the furniture, and sunset from the window crosses her white ruffled apron.
data.animaCaption: She lifts the chair just above the tabletop with one hand on its back and one under the seat.
